results.title: Germany CROs - Contract Research Map
results.content: GermanyA&M STABTEST GmbH is a leading GMP-certified service laboratory specializing in pharmaceutical analytics and stability testing, with locations in Bergheim and Mainz. Founded in 1995 as a spin-off from A&M Labor für Analytik und Metabolismusforschung GmbH, the company has grown into one of the largest providers of analytical services in Europe. A&M STABTEST offers comprehensive analytical support for active pharmaceutical ingredients and drug products throughout development, quality control, and regulatory submission. Its service portfolio includes method development and validation, stability studies, mass spectrometry, bioassays, protein analytics, as well as in vitro and in vivo analytics. A key strength of the company is its extensive regulatory experience: Since 1995 A&M STABTEST continuously adapts its GMP system to evolving regulatory requirements and has undergone multiple successful inspections by the U.S. FDA since 2001. The company invests continually in state-of-the-art laboratory technologies—such as advanced LC-MS systems for protein, oligonucleotide and vialr vector analytical services—and is expanding its service offering in future-oriented areas including cell and gene therapies.

results.title: Professor Manuel Salto-Tellez
results.content: Professor Manuel Salto-Tellez (MD-LMS, FRCPath, FRCPI) is the Professor of Integrative Pathology at The Institute for Cancer Research, London, and the lead of Joint Integrated Pathology Unit at The Institute of Cancer Research (ICR) and The Royal Marsden NHS Foundation Trust. Professor Salto-Tellez is author or co-author of more than 320 internationally peer-reviewed articles in translational science, molecular pathology and diagnostics, has published a similar number of abstracts in international conferences, and is editor or contributor to some of the key textbooks of pathology and oncology. Manuel's research activity has always been at the interface of phenotype and genotype – allowing the application of genomic analysis, digital pathology & artificial intelligence, and integrated diagnostics in creating a new generation of complex, meaningful biomarkers in cancer.
